name: Framekeep Public API
description: Versioned, read-only public product discovery for Framekeep. The v1 contract is backward compatible; breaking changes use a new major path. Deprecations are announced with Deprecation, Sunset, and successor-version Link headers at least 90 days before removal. Private and mutating gallery routes are deliberately excluded.
